rules.message: Filter controls are namespaced per column — every control's name starts with f- (e.g. f-status).
Filtering is idempotent navigation — the filter form GETs the grid URL (data-hx-get), never posts.
The filter must declare where the grid lives: data-hx-target on the form.
data-hx-target must resolve to the grid element the server re-renders.
Target the datagrid wrapper by id (e.g. #items-grid) — the trigger's filtered state lives in the header, so the whole grid (header + rows) must re-render together.
Keep action + method="get" on the filter form so Apply works without JavaScript.
Dropping a condition is navigation: .hc-filterbar__remove must be an <a href> to the URL without that param, so it works without JavaScript and Back puts the condition back.
A remove control must name its condition (aria-label="Remove Status filter"), never a bare ×.
Each condition chip should open the editor for its own condition: popovertarget on .hc-filterbar__chip.
Clear all is navigation too: .hc-filterbar__clear needs an href to the unfiltered URL.
